title: Pixxel sets up US subsidiary to serve federal agencies
summary: Pixxel sets up US subsidiary to serve federal agencies
detailed: Pixxel in September raised $100 million (around Rs 945 crore) in the largest funding round in India’s spacetech sector, co-led by Singapore sovereign wealth fund Temasek and UK-based space investor Seraphim, ET reported.
